builds.name: Pop Blossom ceiling
builds.summary: Pop Blossom slam is 550+1.2 AP. AP/penetration maximizes a single cast; disguise conceals delivery but adds no damage.
builds.goal: Pop Blossom slam is 550+1.2 AP. AP/penetration maximizes a single cast; disguise conceals delivery but adds no damage.
builds.hypothesis:
After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for [0.6 / 0.6 / 0.6] seconds. She then crashes down, dealing [150 / 350 / 550 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for [0.75 / 0.75 / 0.75] seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. [0.5] seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.
